lifecycles.name: Client to Account
lifecycles.domain: Client Onboarding, KYC & Financial Crime Compliance
lifecycles.description: Institutional and retail client intake, Customer Identification Program (CIP), Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) verification, OFAC/PEP screening, Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), and core deposit account activation.

lifecycles.name: Loan to Settlement
lifecycles.domain: Commercial & Retail Lending, Credit Risk & Servicing
lifecycles.description: Credit facility application, financial spreading, quantitative PD/LGD underwriting, collateral lien perfection, loan boarding and funding, covenant monitoring, and subledger-to-GL settlement.

raci_definitions.role_relationship_manager: Responsible for front-office client relationship coverage, onboarding intake, and credit facility structuring.
raci_definitions.role_kyc_aml_analyst: Responsible for CIP documentary verification, UBO graph validation, sanctions/PEP alert disposition, and EDD dossier compilation.
raci_definitions.role_bsa_compliance_officer: Accountable for Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), AML/KYC regulatory compliance, OFAC sanctions escalations, and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) approvals.
raci_definitions.role_credit_underwriter: Responsible for borrower financial spreading, PD/LGD credit risk modeling, DSCR/LTV analysis, and ongoing covenant testing.
raci_definitions.role_chief_credit_officer: Accountable for Credit Committee underwriting approvals, risk policy exceptions, and troubled debt restructuring workouts.
raci_definitions.role_loan_servicing_specialist: Responsible for collateral lien perfection, core banking loan booking, rate resets, and P&I payment administration.
raci_definitions.role_treasury_operations_officer: Accountable for funding liquidity verification, Fedwire/ACH principal disbursement release, and loan subledger reconciliation.
